**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000 USD  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $1 100 000 USD  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Value Index” (latest update 2024‑05)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau – American Community Survey (ACS) 5‑year estimates, 2022‑2024  

> **Why the difference?**  
> • The *median* is the middle value of all home prices and is less affected by extremely expensive properties.  
> • The *average* (mean) is higher because a small number of very high‑priced homes pull the mean upward.  

If you need a more precise figure for a specific city or ZIP code, let me know!
